raw_packet.full_request:
덕테이프 포스터로 동네 생활수리 워크숍을 홍보해줘. SNS와 지역 커뮤니티에 올릴 16:9 가로 포스터 다섯 장이 필요해. 다섯 장은 전체 스타일과 구도가 서로 달랐으면 좋겠어. 의자나 옷을 함께 고치는 경험이 시각적으로 느껴져야 하고, 설명부터 일정·장소·비용·신청 안내까지 자연스럽게 읽히게 해줘. 본문을 작게 구석에 밀어 넣지 말아줘. 단색 바탕의 큰 고딕 제목·정보 블록에 작은 그림만 붙인 구성, 빈 방을 글자판으로 쓴 구성은 제외해줘. 로고·QR·새 문구 없이 아래 문구를 각 한 번씩 정확히 넣어줘.

고쳐 쓰는 토요일
REPAIR / TOGETHER

헐거워진 의자와 찢어진 옷을 가져오세요. 이웃 수리자와 도구를 나누며 다시 쓰는 방법을 배웁니다.

procedure.method: Independent fresh editorial session. Read the exact pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, method README, addendum, adapter, ratio policy, and all five pinned native-evidence manifests; verified all 33 permitted input pins by SHA-256 and byte count and all 15 PNG header dimensions. Packet source_assets and protected_layouts are empty, so there were no source-image opens or protected-geometry reads. Actually opened and displayed each exact poster individually using tools.view_image with detail original, through functions.exec/image, strictly M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4, and M5 in that same within-member order. Completed all 15 successful displayed poster views before beginning the first deliberate copy-reading/transcription stage, any judgment, or score. Transcribed all 12 entries once per member in packet order from the viewed native pixels, preserving first readings and visible soft wrapping; no glyph ambiguity was found and no image revisit occurred. Judged native detail, use-size readability, thumbnail organization, and all five systems together only after the completed viewing/transcription stages. Every native is 1672x941; this is not mathematically exact 16:9, but its height differs from 1672*9/16 by exactly 0.5 px and passes the pinned nearest-integer-single-edge policy. Exact supplied use views are 720x405 and thumbnails 320x180, aspect-preserving rounded downsample sizes. No images were produced, edited, substituted, or cropped. No producer explanation, unlisted embedded path, peer review, earlier score, or additional critic was inspected or invoked. Session identity is not observable here and remains null.

procedure.method: In this fresh independent session I read the exact packet, case, pinned rubric, review rules, method/addendum and adapter. I read all five pinned native-evidence manifests before any poster open and verified the 33 supplied input pins and PNG dimensions. The packet declares no source assets and no protected-layout manifests, so actual separate source opens and protected-layout reads are zero. I then sequentially called tools.view_image with detail original and emitted each exact pinned image at original detail: M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in the same order. All fifteen successful poster displays were inspected before beginning the first copy-transcription stage, any mandatory judgment or any image/set score. Only after M5 thumbnail320 was displayed did I read and transcribe the native images already visible in the conversation, in twelve-entry packet order per member. No OCR, crops, replacement assets, image edits, peer reviews or maker records were used. There were no unresolved glyph ambiguities and no ambiguity revisits. All poster natives are 1672×941, usage views 720×405, and thumbnails 320×180; native ratio correctness uses the declared 0.5-pixel single-edge rounding allowance. space.location: left column against cropped right illustration
space.observation: The left column has a consistent outer margin and a controlled sequence of gaps, while large chair and garment crops keep the right side active.

image_material.location: hands, wood grain and fabric folds
image_material.observation: Two-color hatch marks and white knockouts remain consistent across hands, rails and cloth; recognizable joint and stitch details survive close inspection.

image_material.location: right-side repair actions
image_material.observation: The large cropping preserves the chair-joining and sewing gestures at use size; the exact needle contact is finer than the otherwise strong object silhouettes.

emotion_control.location: red date and red/navy working hands
emotion_control.observation: The restrained but forceful print palette gives the invitation an earnest collective-work tone; the red stitches connect the accent color to the repair action.

emotion_control.location: worn objects and hands rather than facial spectacle
emotion_control.observation: Material care and practical participation carry the mood, with no unrelated celebratory or luxury imagery.

ai_slop.location: rail tenon, supporting fingers, shirt buttons and patch
ai_slop.observation: The details belong to the named tasks and keep coherent object roles; no invented text or unrelated decorative motif is visible.
The graphic treatment is consistent and the type remains clean; fine sewing contact is a minor detail limit rather than a dominant generated contradiction.

residuals: The very large date receives attention before the event title; this is a coherent event-led choice but makes the poster less immediately title-led than M1 or M2.
The lower practical block is compact at usage720, and the smallest entries are not comfortably readable at thumbnail320.
The exact needle contact is less explicit than the large garment and chair silhouettes; the print-like work is strong professional execution without exceptional local refinement.

evidence.location: whole composition in relation to M2–M5
evidence.observation: A continuous warm photographic scene wraps people around a central tabletop text column. Its ambient depth, portrait scale and downward information route differ from the graphic hand circuit, angular detail collage, painted central figures and date-led left column.

evidence.location: perimeter action circuit and central logistics grid
evidence.observation: Cropped illustrated hands, two chair views, tool handoff and red thread circulate around a broad central opening. Invitation and two-row logistics, with a top-right heading, distinguish it spatially from M1 despite both using central copy; it does not share M4’s central portrait with flanking text.

evidence.location: angular collage, lower-left title and pale center polygon
evidence.observation: Photographic damaged and mended details are divided into diagonal panels, with white display words distributed across image fields and practical copy grouped in the center. This changes image editing, crop scale and reading route relative to M1’s continuous photograph and both illustrated systems.

evidence.location: central painted pair, foreground sewing and text on both sides
evidence.observation: A large painted human scene and foreground garment hands divide left explanation/application from right title/logistics. This is a distinct central-figure system, even though red/blue clothing and chair repair recur in M2; its information fragmentation is a quality weakness retained separately from diversity.

evidence.location: red date and single left column beside right repair crop
evidence.observation: The red serif date leads a left editorial column with brush-like Korean copy and sans-serif logistics; navy/red print-like hands and objects dominate the right. Its type roles and single-column route differ from M2’s perimeter montage despite both using hatch-textured illustration.

Both M1 and M2 reserve a center for copy, but M1 has a narrow continuous vertical column inside a real table scene while M2 uses a wide invitation/paragraph and horizontal event grid inside a circuit of isolated gestures. The distinction is greater than a material substitution.

M5 keeps event and application information in one left route; M4 splits these functions across three areas around portraits. Their viewpoints, crops and type roles differ as well as their rendering materials.

residuals: All five repeat the same two repair subjects and mostly dark type against light reading areas; this is a shared content constraint and some family resemblance, not evidence of five unique concepts by material names alone.

M1 and M2 both create central text openings, and M2/M4 share red-and-blue illustrated clothing; their whole spatial systems nevertheless differ enough for a diversity judgment of 4, rather than exceptional 5.
M4 retains scores of 3 for hierarchy and space and a literal style failure for the disconnected event/application route. Set diversity does not cancel those findings.
